# Architecture projection source fixtures

These are small, licensed subsets of DigitalBoneBox and Flask's tutorial, copied byte-for-byte from the revisions recorded in each `provenance.json`. Each subject includes its upstream license. The manifests record original paths and SHA-256 content hashes; the reviewed expected sets remain in `docs/evaluation/architecture-discovery/expected`.

Tests scan temporary copies as **local content**, never as fabricated upstream Git commits. Scripted reference replies exercise projection and traceability, not model quality. Files are read as data; repository code is never imported, built or run. No network access or provider credentials are needed. The fixture attributes preserve exact bytes on both Windows and Linux.
